name: PLP Penetrant Lube

features.text: Stop squeaks on the trunk, hood, and door hinges

description: PLP Penetrant Lube has a fast-acting penetrating formula that frees rusted nuts, bolts, and other parts. This versatile product displaces moisture, forms a protective coating and prevents the formation of rust on metal surfaces. PLP leaves a lubricating film to reduce sticking, wear and squeaks in moving parts. Industrial uses: lubricates and prevents rust on machine parts and equipment. May be used for easy assembly and disassembly. Automotive uses: penetrates rusted intake-manifold bolts, heat risers, exhaust systems, wheel lug nuts, suspension bolts, and control linkages. Displaces water and moisture from electrical contacts, connections and distributors.
application: NOT FOR SALE OR USE IN CALIFORNIA OR OTC STATES Directions: Shake Well Before Using For hard-to-reach areas, use extension tube. To penetrate: spray freely on frozen parts, tap lightly, allow a few minutes to penetrate. On heavily rusted parts, it may be necessary to repeat the application. To prevent rust and corrosion: spray all parts regularly to maintain a barrier. To displace moisture: spray parts or surfaces, wait a few minutes and wipe off with a clean cloth. To lubricate: spray parts or surfaces liberally.

ad.headline: Protect & Lubricate
ad.description: PLP penetrating lubricant penetrates stuck parts, protects metal from rust and corrosion, and displaces moisture. PLP lubricates between small spaces to keep moving parts like wheels, hinges, chains and gears moving smoothly.
benefits: Frees sticky, frozen or rusted metal parts.
Lubricates moving parts such as hinges and gears.
